name: homeiq-1
description: **Homeiq** is a web-based platform where users can buy, sell, rent, and lease properties. Using modern technologies, the system provides a seamless experience with authentication, image management, and a user-friendly interface. The project is built with React and Vite on the frontend and Node.js/Express on the backend.
